blurb: The GERONIMO! Skydiving Team is a premier civilian exhibition skydiving team with over 45 years of experience. They perform custom-tailored skydiving shows including flying giant Canadian and American flags, smoke trails, banners, and specialty jumps. They provide professional ground crew, announcers, and interaction with spectators and sponsors at events.
